title: Spyglass: Now Live!
summary: The powerful Spyglass tool has officially launched, moving beyond beta to offer an even more refined and impactful experience for all users.

title: Enhanced File Control in Your Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage your images and files directly within the editor with new controls to upload, download, remove, and even customize how they appear in your content.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We're excited to launch a dedicated roadmap page where you can easily explore our latest shipped features, see what's coming next, and discover our long-term plans.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've significantly upgraded our checkboxes, making them bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable for a more intuitive and efficient workflow.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've refined our editor to offer a truly seamless and intuitive collaborative experience, making teamwork more productive than ever.

title: Effortless Collaboration and Access
summary: Now you can effortlessly discover and collaborate on all relevant shared content with your friends and colleagues, enhancing your collective productivity.

title: Noeko in Your Language
summary: Get ready for Noeko in your language, as we launch comprehensive international language support to empower users around the world.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's exciting future.

title: Smarter Knowledge Graph
summary: Discover insights faster and navigate your knowledge effortlessly with powerful new filtering options and enhanced exploration capabilities in your personalized knowledge graph.

title: Refined Search and Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint specific information within your knowledge base by applying advanced filters and saving your tailored searches as dynamic collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: Get ready to intuitively structure your thoughts with enhanced visual layouts and interactive previews for your connected content.

title: Introducing Noeko: Self-Hosted Freedom and Enterprise Power
summary: Experience the full power of Noeko with new self-hosting options and flexible premium plans designed to scale with your team's needs.

title: Stunning New and Improved Themes
summary: Prepare for a vibrant visual refresh as we meticulously polish our current themes and expand our collection with exciting, brand-new options designed to personalize your experience.

title: Smarter Time-Aware Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more accurate and welcoming homepage experience as we refine our time-based greetings to perfectly match your local time.

title: Seamless Tag and Item Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items and content directly from your lists, allowing you to unapply tags or delete entries with unprecedented ease and speed.

title: Expand Your Knowledge: New Content Sources
summary: Centralize and enrich your information hub by seamlessly integrating a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, for a truly comprehensive knowledge experience.
